_comment: Copy this file to config.json (same directory) and edit it. config.json is gitignored because it names paths on your machine. Relative values resolve against the page URL, so a bare file name is looked up next to this file. An /@fs/ path is served by `npm run dev` only, and only for a directory listed in LOCAL_DATA_DIRS, e.g. `LOCAL_DATA_DIRS=/home/YOU/galaxytools npm run dev` — a config containing one must never be deployed.
